title: Highlight candidates for an event
description: clips/work/<event>/highlights.json. The agent writes event, source_transcript and each candidate's id, segments, quotes and optional note. clips.py (preview, choose, burn) writes cut, chosen and crop. Run `clips.py status` for a human-readable view.

source_transcript.description: Path to the transcript this file was built from, relative to the repo root, e.g. clips/work/<event>/transcript.json.

id.description: 1..N, in the order the candidates were defined. Never renumber: files in final/ are named after it.

start_seg.description: Index of the first segment of the clip (transcript.json segments[].i).

end_seg.description: Index of the last segment of the clip (inclusive).

start_quote.description: Exact text of the first segment (start_seg): a checksum against the transcript, and the words the start edge is placed on.

end_quote.description: Exact text of the last segment (end_seg): a checksum against the transcript, and the words the end edge is placed on.

note.description: Optional, English: what the moment is and anything to check (planned drops, garbled transcript, needs the slides).

crop.description: Set by `clips.py burn --crop`. W:H:X:Y in source pixels: the part of the picture this clip shows. Absent means the whole frame.

chosen.description: Set by the choose subcommand. True if a human picked this candidate to be cut.

cut.description: Written by clips.py's preview and choose subcommands, not by the agent.

segs.description: [start_seg, end_seg] this cut was computed from. preview computes the cut again when the span changes.

edges.description: How each edge was placed: pause (on a pause next to the quoted words), tight (against the next word, no pause there), rough (the words were not found in the new alignment), hand (a time read off the preview player).

preview.description: Written by the preview subcommand. origin is the source time of the preview file's first frame.
